requirements.text: Students should be able to choose from a palette of colours for each module to easily identify them.
Students should be able to toggle off cancelled classes with a checkbox for a cleaner timetable view.
Students should be able to use a drag-and-drop interface to block out personal study time, with options for recurring or one-off study blocks.
Immediate alerts when grades are posted, ideally within five minutes of submission.
Students should have options for receiving notifications via email, push notifications through the portal, or both, allowing them to configure their preferences.
Reminders for upcoming assignment deadlines and exam dates should be provided with flexibility in delivery methods.
A straightforward feedback form should be available for students to fill out after the teaching period ends, focusing on areas such as content quality, delivery effectiveness, and resources provided.

Rating options for aspects like lecture engagement, helpfulness of materials, and fairness of assessments should be included, along with open-ended questions for more detailed comments and suggestions.
The submission process for feedback should be user-friendly, perhaps through a simple button on the portal, ensuring that feedback is aggregated and anonymised before reaching module coordinators.
Feedback should only be made available to coordinators after the grade submission deadline to avoid any influence on grading decisions.
The enhancements must comply with all relevant regulations like GDPR.
